name: io.github.lahma/sonarqube-mcp
description: SonarQube Cloud over MCP: projects, quality gates, issues, security hotspots, measures, coverage and issue triage.

environmentVariables.name: SONARQUBE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: SonarQube Cloud user token, sent as a Bearer credential. Create one at https://sonarcloud.io/account/security and pick the User Token type - a project analysis token is not accepted by these endpoints. Without it the server still starts and reads public projects anonymously, but nothing private is reachable and no write tool works.

environmentVariables.name: SONARQUBE_ORG
environmentVariables.description: Organization key - the last segment of https://sonarcloud.io/organizations/{key}. Only listProjects and getRule require it, and a public organization answers both anonymously, so it is optional; set it and every project in that organization becomes discoverable.

environmentVariables.name: SONARQUBE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the SonarQube Cloud instance. Defaults to https://sonarcloud.io; the only other accepted host is https://sonarqube.us. SonarQube Server is out of scope and any other value is ignored.

environmentVariables.name: SONARQUBE_MCP_DEFAULT_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: Project key used when a tool call omits projectKey. It is the id in a sonarcloud.io project URL, not the repository name. Setting it is worth it when this server is configured per checkout.

environmentVariables.name: SONARQUBE_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to register only the fifteen read tools. The four write tools - transitionIssue, assignIssue, addIssueComment and setHotspotStatus - are then absent from tools/list rather than refused when called.
